purpose: Thesis Break Monitor: given a changed EvidenceRecord (NEW/POTENTIALLY_SUPERSEDED/REMOVED_OR_MISSING per D0105) and an existing ResearchArtifact scenario (Bull/Base/Bear), determine whether the evidence SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATION/NEUTRAL/UNKNOWN that scenario's hypothesis, and whether the scenario requires human review. A deterministic gate (identity, materiality, PIT, D0104 lineage, ACCEPT-only) always runs before any optional model-assisted semantic interpretation; a model may never override a deterministic failure. This module answers only 'what does this evidence imply', never 'what is the new final thesis' -- no automatic thesis rewrite, no BUY/SELL, no expected return, no valuation, no confidence mutation. See forbidden_actions for the full list of prohibited out-of-scope operations for this task; those are constraints on the executor, not requests.
requested_actions: implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/evidence/thesis_impact.py providing assess_thesis_impact(): a deterministic gate (evidence identity/materiality/PIT/D0104 lineage/ACCEPT-only) that must pass before any optional model-assisted semantic classification into the existing EvidenceRelation vocabulary (SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATION/NEUTRAL/UNKNOWN)
reuse lib.disclosures.evidence_lineage.resolve_evidence_lineage() for lineage verification; do not duplicate its traversal logic
reuse lib.evidence.model.EvidenceRelation exactly; do not add new relation synonyms

define a narrow Protocol for optional model-assisted classification (mirroring CandidateExtractionModel / FaithfulnessVerifier), with schema-constrained output (reject unknown keys, invalid enum values, or attempts to rewrite the hypothesis/assign BUY-SELL)
ensure REMOVED_OR_MISSING evidence never automatically becomes CONTRADICTS, and unassigned NEW evidence is never auto-attached to a scenario by semantic similarity
ensure Bull/Base/Bear scenarios are assessed independently (no single global relation forced across scenarios)

add unit tests in Japanese_Equity_Lab/13_tests/test_thesis_impact.py covering the required scenarios (contradiction, support, alternative explanation, neutral, unknown, removed evidence, lineage failure, PIT-invalid, non-ACCEPT, scenario isolation, unassigned evidence, ResearchArtifact immutability, model contract violations)
run ruff check and mypy --strict on thesis_impact.py
run the targeted pytest suite for test_thesis_impact.py
record any design decision in DECISIONS.md
forbidden_actions: no portfolio construction or position sizing
no collapsing CONTRADICTS and ALTERNATIVE_EXPLANATION into one meaning
no treating REMOVED_OR_MISSING evidence as CONTRADICTS or FALSE
no auto-attaching unassigned NEW evidence to a Bull/Base/Bear scenario by semantic similarity
no numerical impact/materiality score (0-100 or otherwise)
no model call that overrides a deterministic gate failure
no real external model call in automated tests (fake/stub model only)
no edits to any frozen_files entry
